svg.title: Multi-level BOM of VC20-300 with quantities and costs
svg.text: 04 – Multi-level bill of materials of the VC20-300 (manufacturing BOM, example values)
Boxes: item · type · qty per parent × unit cost. Grey = MAKE. Red border = config raw material. The split of the config "other parts" $140 is an ASSUMPTION.
Low-level code (LLC) = deepest level of an item in any BOM:
VC20-300 = 0 · pump assy, tank, motor, kits = 1 · machined parts, pistons … = 2 · castings, forging = 3.
MRP nets level by level (0, 1, 2, 3), so each item is netted once, after all its parents (chapter 19.4).
Explosion of WO 100 × VC20 with planned scrap: gross = qty × qty per ÷ (1 − scrap)
Scrap rates = config base_scrap_rate. Round UP: one part short stops the order.
BOM types (chapter 19.2): EBOM (engineering, from PLM, by function) ▶ MBOM (manufacturing, this drawing: by assembly step) ▶ service BOM (spare parts).
Phantom: a pump assembly that is never stocked can be a phantom – MRP passes its demand straight to the children.
